scope: Bookmark without toast, companion line chart, varied seeded history, borderless record panels and heatmap tooltips
browser: isolated Chromium with 1440px, 768px, 390px and 320px viewport emulation

checks: Bookmark still saves immediately
Bookmark retains its short icon motion
Saving does not display a bottom-right notification
Removing a bookmark does not display a notification
Character time is shown as three initially selected line series
The current week has its own smaller group of study companions
Summary, calendar and record panels have no outer borders
1440px: chart and records stay inside the page
주: ring displays the same focus rate as its semantic value
주: date tooltip has no outer border
월: ring displays the same focus rate as its semantic value
월: date tooltip has no outer border
년: ring displays the same focus rate as its semantic value
년: date tooltip has no outer border
Weekly, monthly and yearly focus rates are distinct
Annual heatmap includes study in every elapsed month
Annual comparison includes all nineteen characters
Keyboard Home reveals the first month and character measurements
Arrow keys update the chart date
Character legend toggles its own series
A character at the end of the scrollable selector can be compared
Reduced motion removes line entrance animation
768px: records fit the viewport
768px: chart uses real pixel dimensions for readable labels
390px: records fit the viewport
390px: chart uses real pixel dimensions for readable labels
320px: records fit the viewport
320px: chart uses real pixel dimensions for readable labels
Room filter scopes chart data to that room’s characters
No runtime or console errors

limitations: Physical mobile devices and other browser engines were not exercised.
Focus measurements and history remain frontend demo data.
artifacts: Development-only screenshots and runner in /private/tmp/capsule-records-lines and /private/tmp/capsule-wireframe-browser/records-lines-qa.mjs.
